title: Kiti ya bokonzi oyo etambolaki na mbala moko
intro: Moto moko ya bokonzi monene azalaki koyangela bokonzi moko ya bozwi oyo epambolamaki na bozwi oyo eleki ndelo. Ntango mokakatano moko oyo akanisaki te ebimaki, mokonzi yango akutanaki na komekama ya mipanga te kasi ya mayele mpe ya kondima. Oyo ekobima ekokamba uta na nsɔngɛ ya nguya ya mokili kino na mbongwana monene ya motema.
clues: Nayangelaki bokonzi oyo epambolamaki na bozwi mpe bozwi oyo eleki makanisi
Nazalaki mokonzi moko ya nguya oyo azwaki mokanda moko ya mpiko oyo ezalaki kosɛnga ete bátosa ye
Bato na ngai ya lokumu bapesaki ngai toli mpo na koyeba soki nasengeli kobunda to kosala kimya na mokonzi wana oyo azalaki mosika
Nabandaki mobembo na makabo ya kokamwa mpo na kokutana na mokonzi oyo ya mosika ngai moko
Kiti na ngai ya bokonzi ememamaki na mokili moko ya mosika na mbala moko, liboso nakoka kozonga
Ntango nakɔtaki na ndako moko ya mokonzi oyo ezalaki na mabele oyo ezalaki pɛtɛɛ lokola vitre, nsukansuka nasakolaki ete namikitisi epai ya Allah

location.label: Elemento ya ntina

options: Komikitisa epai ya Allah pembeni ya mosakoli

Kobikisama na ndenge ya likamwisi na mɔ́tɔ oyo ezalaki kopela
Bokangami uta na elanga ya esengo ya seko
Kozwa bokonzi ya nguya monene
outcome.answer: Komikitisa epai ya Allah pembeni ya mosakoli

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
